items.text: "I forgot, I'm sorry. I've put a reminder in so it won't happen again."
"You made me angry, so it's your fault I shouted."
items.why: Nobody makes us shout. Feelings explain; they don't excuse.

items.text: "I was wrong to say that. Can we talk about it?"

items.why: A 'sorry you feel' apology avoids owning the action.

items.text: "I was stressed, but that's no reason to take it out on you."
"Everyone does it, it's not a big deal."
"I cancelled late. Let me make it up to you: Saturday?"
"If you hadn't nagged me I'd have done it."
"I didn't realise that hurt. Thanks for telling me."
"I only did it because I was drunk."
